description: Read up to 100 Kafka messages without committing consumer offsets. Defaults to the latest 20 messages. Returns JSON with base64 payloads, UTF-8 previews, metadata, incomplete (partial broker read), and outputTruncated (256 KiB message output budget). Only Kafka is supported.

connection_id.description: Unique ID of the DBX connection

offset.description: Non-negative offset, required only for start_position=offset

partition.description: Non-negative partition; omit to read across partitions

start_position.description: Read latest messages (default), earliest messages, or from an offset

name: dbx_peek_messages
